title: Scientific Modelling and Dimensional Analysis
summary: One versioned model record for three tools. This preview runs the Dimensionless Number Finder and the Model Nondimensionalizer: enter variables with units, equations and conditions; the page checks dimensions, units, absolute and difference temperatures, conditions and closures before analysis. The Finder builds the dimension matrix, row-reduces it with exact rational arithmetic, selects repeating variables and returns the n − r independent groups with their exponent equations, cancellation and rank checks, familiar names from stored formulas and an equivalent familiar basis. The Nondimensionalizer suggests scales from the geometry, the prescribed values and the balance of two terms, shows competing scales and refuses a zero scale, then substitutes into every equation and condition with exact symbolic algebra, removes each common factor, lists the remaining parameters, compares them with the Pi basis and checks the reverse substitution. Every result carries one of six statuses, its inputs, its derivation and its sources; a SymPy reference script checks the engine. Worked examples from the specification and failure examples, a Markdown report and a narrated beamdswitch deck from the same model version. Works offline: MathJax 4.1.3 and Fira Math are embedded.
